body.message:
We truly understand how frustrating this situation must be for you, and we are sincerely sorry for the inconvenience caused.

Please be assured that we have already informed our Finance Team and are continuously following up with them regarding your refund. It is currently going through the required approval process, and we are doing our best to have it completed as soon as possible.

We completely understand that you have been waiting, and we truly appreciate your patience and understanding. Unfortunately, as the payment has already been processed and the refund is currently under process, we are unable to provide the refund in cash at this stage.

Please find our office details below for your reference. We sincerely apologize once again and hope for your kind understanding while we work to complete the process.

Office Location : Bay Square

Bulling : 13

Office : 306

Link: https://maps.app.goo.gl/3mLFVyanQicuaayG7
